findings.source_quote: A Christ-centered Courtship is a series of messages on godly courtship preached by Paul Hershberger.
findings.suggested_fix: Translate and preserve meaning: replace the Hebrew phrase that reads "חתונה עבריינית אלוהית" with a correct rendering of "A Christ-centered Courtship" and "godly courtship". For example: keep the HTML and tags unchanged but change the inner text to: "A Christ-centered Courtship" היא סדרת מסרים על חיזור נוצחי/חיזור מושרש במשיח שנשאו פאול הרשברגר. (Or another idiomatic Modern Hebrew rendering of "godly courtship" such as 'חיזור שמרכזו המשיח' or 'חיזור יהודי-נוצרי' consistent with the publication's preferred terminology). Do not introduce or change tags; only substitute the incorrect word "עבריינית" (criminal) with an accurate phrase meaning "godly courtship" or "Christ-centered courtship".
findings.translation_quote: "A Christ-centered Courtship" היא סדרת מסרים על חתונה עבריינית אלוהית שנשאו פאול הרשברגר.

findings.suggested_fix: Title must preserve the original meaning. Replace the Hebrew title "חתונה שממוקדת במשיח" (which reads as 'a marriage focused on Christ') with a translation that preserves the English "Courtship" (the period/process of seeking/matching before marriage). Suggested fix (one of): "חיזור שממוקד במשיח" or "חיזור במרכזו המשיח". Keep the <title> tag structure unchanged; only adjust the text content.

findings.source_quote: Five goals for this Christ-Centered Courtship series. Goal #1. To turn the hearts of the fathers to their children. Goal #2. To turn the hearts of the children to their fathers. Goal #3. That parents would get a burden to lead each one of their children into the perfect will of God for their lives. Goal #4. That young people would get a burden to seek after God, find fulfillment and purpose in walking with God, and you would seek maturity in your manners and in your character. Goal #5. That young men and young women would rise up to be godly fathers and godly mothers with a vision to raise up another godly generation, and the Gospel of Jesus Christ can go on.
findings.suggested_fix:
Translate these English sentences into Hebrew to match the rest of the article and preserve their theological meaning. Keep the same HTML tags and order. Example (literal, adjust style as needed):

חמש מטרות לסדרת החיזור שממוקדת במשיח

followed by five

elements with Hebrew equivalents of each goal, preserving nuance ("turn the hearts of the fathers to their children" → "להחזיר את לב האבות אל ילדיהם", etc.). Do not remove or change scripture references or formatting.
findings.translation_quote:
Five goals for this Christ-Centered Courtship series.
Goal #1. To turn the hearts of the fathers to their children.
Goal #2. To turn the hearts of the children to their fathers.
Goal #3. That parents would get a burden to lead each one of their children into the perfect will of God for their lives.
Goal #4. That young people would get a burden to seek after God, find fulfillment and purpose in walking with God, and you would seek maturity in your manners and in your character.
Goal #5. That young men and young women would rise up to be godly fathers and godly mothers with a vision to raise up another godly generation, and the Gospel of Jesus Christ can go on.

findings.source_quote: Original: "A Christ-centered courtship is a period of time between a single life and a married life." Translation: "חתונה שממוקדת במשיח היא תקופת זמן בין חיים בעודה רווקים לבין חיים נשואים."
findings.suggested_fix: The Hebrew must reflect the concept of 'courtship' (period of seeking before marriage), not 'חתונה' which means 'wedding' or 'marriage'. Change phrasing to use a word for courtship such as 'חיזור' or 'התארגנות לפני הנישואין' and keep the same nuance as the English. Example: 'חיזור שראשו במשיח הוא תקופת זמן בין חיי רווקות לחיי נשואים.' Preserve paragraph tag.
